plans.idea: Centered poster stack: a big headline and subhead on top, a large centered bottle as the focal image, then the badge row, a bold centered CTA, and legal at the foot, so the eye reads straight down from top to bottom with no dead gaps.
Product-first editorial: the bottle fills the top half, then a left-aligned copy block, with the CTA and badges sharing one row on a common left edge, and legal at the bottom.

Asymmetric split: a full-width headline band on top, then a left column with the badges and the CTA stacked and lined up with the bottom of a large bottle on the right, so the offer sits beside the product.
